title: cordyline fragrans
intro: Cordyline fragrans, commonly known as the fragrant dracaena or fragrant cordyline, is a type of flowering plant native to Hawaii and the Pacific Islands. The plant is known for its fragrant white or purple flowers and its ability to grow in a variety of environments. The health benefits of Cordyline fragrans include reducing stress and anxiety due to its calming effects, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of Cordyline fragrans include saponins, flavonoids, and other compounds that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions.
